sources.title: DeepCoder: A Fully Open-Source 14B Coder at O3-mini Level
sources.snippet: Through a joint collaboration between the Agentica team and Together AI, we release DeepCoder-14B-Preview, a code reasoning model finetuned from Deepseek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-14B via distributed RL. It achieves an impressive 60.6% Pass@1 accuracy on LiveCodeBench (+8% improvement), matching the performance of o3-mini-2025-01-031 (Low) and o1-2024-12-17 with just 14B parameters. We've open ...
